prompt.en: A neem tree must stand upright, day and night, for many years. Explain why muscle tissue, like the muscle in a rabbit's leg, would be a poor way to hold the tree up. Compare it with the cell wall.

label.en: Muscle needs energy the whole time it holds

level1.en: Think of your arm holding a heavy bag out straight. What does the muscle use the whole time?

clue.en: A muscle stays tight only while it keeps using energy, and it gets tired.

level2Template.en: To hold the tree up, muscle would have to keep using ___ all the time.

label.en: A cell wall holds without using energy

level1.en: What does a stiff cell wall need in order to keep its shape?

clue.en: Once it is made, a cell wall stays stiff by itself.

level2Template.en: A cell wall stays stiff by itself, so it holds the plant up without ___.

text.en: Muscle holds a load only while it keeps using energy, and it gets tired.
A stiff cell wall keeps its shape without using energy, year after year.
